class.name: NNArea2DSearchSpace
class.brief_description: Returns overlapping [Area2D] nodes within an [Area2D] as a search space.
class.description: This node uses an [Area2D] to define the search space. It connects to the [signal Area2D.area_entered] and [signal Area2D.area_exited] signals of [member area2d] to track overlapping [Area2D] nodes in [member intersecting_areas], and returns those [Area2D] nodes as the search space. Physics bodies are not tracked or included.

members.member: The areas intersecting or within the set area. Useful when debugging the search space.
